final: WITH f AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry AS zone, s.entrystat AS entry, sf.traitcount AS tc FROM scanfeatures sf JOIN sites s ON sf.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sf.traitcount > 489) SELECT zone AS site_code, entry AS entry_status, AVG(tc) AS avg_traitcount, COUNT(*) AS record_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) AS share FROM f GROUP BY zone, entry HAVING (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM f) > 0 ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
